integrity: The all-length classification follows from explicit diagonal shift-root identities, a bounded inverse-Cesaro construction and topological arguments; finite checks alone do not prove it. scientific_limitations: Finite orthogonal sums of positive weighted unilateral shifts with each weight uniformly above zero and below a finite bound. No fixed universal bound independent of the target continuum; no result for arbitrary bounded-below operators or infinite sums. The scalar asymptotic numerical range loses nonconvex joint information.
title: Every positive compact continuum occurs as a root-cluster set of finite sums of weighted shifts
